description: This file defines the FloatingRatePeriodData class, a data transfer object (DTO) for representing a period of floating rate within the Fineract project. It includes fields such as id, fromDate, interestRate, and flags indicating activity and rate differential status, along with methods for comparison, equality, and hash code implementations.

classes.name: FloatingRatePeriodData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a floating rate period with properties like id, fromDate, interestRate, and activity flags. Implements comparison and equality methods to facilitate sorting and object comparison.

methods.name: FloatingRatePeriodData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties, including identification, date, interest rate, activity, and audit fields.

methods.name: FloatingRatePeriodData
methods.description: Overloaded constructor initializing core properties, excluding audit fields.

methods.name: getFromDateAsLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the fromDate property as a LocalDate object; annotated to ignore during JSON serialization.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Provides a comparison logic based on id, fromDate, and isActive to enable sorting of FloatingRatePeriodData instances.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines object equality based on id, fromDate, and isActive fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on id, fromDate, and isActive fields.
